text: dsh-whileplay 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的休闲游戏插件，在对话输入区旁注册可浮动的游戏面板，让用户等待模型回复时玩一小局。界面列出飞机大战、坦克大战、贪吃蛇、国际象棋和五子棋，并提供任务联动演练；棋类支持电脑对弈或本地双人。游戏可暂停和继续，面板支持收起与调整大小。它适合想在 DSH 对话间隙放松一下的用户；代码实现了浏览器本地存档，未发现需要配置 API Key 或账号的功能。

dsh-whileplay adds a floating game panel beside the DSH web composer. Play Air Battle, Tank Battle, Snake, Chess or Gomoku between replies; board games offer computer or local play. Pause games or collapse the panel. Saves use browser storage; no API key or account setup is shown.
想在等 DSH 回复时玩一局简单的小游戏。
能不能在对话输入框旁边打开一个可收起的游戏面板？
I want to play chess or Gomoku in the browser while waiting for a DSH response.
dsh-whileplay 的功能「对话间隙游戏」：在 DSH Web 对话输入区旁打开游戏面板，选择飞机大战、坦克大战、贪吃蛇、国际象棋或五子棋；棋类可选电脑或本地双人对弈。游戏支持暂停、继续和收起窗口。

**AI 推进任务，你守住航程。**

Whileplay 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的任务联动游戏插件。当前会话的 Todo 化作海上航程，工具调用带来拦截机和补给，完成子任务的 Agent 加入护航编队，交付文件装上运输船。你驾驶战机，在 AI 工作的同时移动、射击、闪避，护送成果前行。

六款游戏，两种等待的节奏：飞机大战、坦克大战和贪吃蛇把工具调用变成目标与补给；国际象棋和五子棋让你静下来下一局，支持本地电脑对手与同屏双人。

一边让 AI 继续工作，一边打一小局。需要你查看回复或处理审批时，游戏会自动暂停。

dsh-whileplay README · 为什么试试玩一小局：- **每个任务，都有自己的航程。** 任务标题、Todo、Agent 编队和交付清单跟随当前会话更新；没有收到的数据明确显示为空。
- **亲手操作的实时战斗。** 四向移动、自动射击、冲刺、修复与空袭；任务事件改变战场，游戏胜负不会影响 AI 执行。
- **动静皆宜的六款游戏。** 想操作就移动、射击、护航；想思考就与电脑或朋友对弈，胜负都有明确结算。
- **游戏窗口随手摆放。** 支持拖动和缩放，进入游戏和返回游戏库保持相同位置与尺寸；经典游戏与棋类均提供极简模式。
- **随时回到正事。** 会话结束运行、等待审批或需要补充信息时自动暂停；回来后再继续这一局。
- **装好就能试玩。** 四款动作与街机游戏提供无需模型的「联动演练」，两款棋类提供本地对弈。经典游戏与棋类支持中英文和浅深色主题；远征目前使用中文界面。

dsh-whileplay README · 开始游玩：打开 `dsh web` 在终端输出的**完整 URL**，完成网页认证。点击聊天输入框旁的 **「◈ 玩一小局」**，选择游戏，再开始游玩。动作与街机游戏可以通过 **「联动演练」** 体验目标和道具；国际象棋与五子棋点击 **「开始对弈」** 即可开局。

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 小队护送远征：让当前任务进入战场：护送运输船穿过岛屿与礁石，用战机挡住敌人的进攻。移动、自动锁敌、闪避弹幕和收集补给组成持续的实时战斗；任务信息同时显示在战场和右侧简报中。

| 当前任务发生了什么 | 战场如何响应 |
| --- | --- |
| 生成或更新 Todo | 航点显示真实 Todo 标题和状态，航程随任务进展更新 |
| 调用工具 | 带工具名称的拦截机入场；工具返回不会让它突然消失 |
| 工具成功返回 / Step 结束 | 分别投放火力 / 护盾补给，移动拾取后生效 |
| 子 Agent 完成任务 | 确认本轮完成的 Agent 成为僚机，最多两架协同射击 |
| 呈交文件 | 运输船显示已交付文件名；普通文件写入不算交付 |
| 会话停止或需要处理交互 | 战场暂停，让你回到会话；不会据此宣称任务成功 |

默认 **「当前会话」** 模式展示真实数据，未提供 Todo、子 Agent 或交付物时显示空态。切换到 **「联动演练」**，可体验「番茄钟小站」的完整示例航程；两种模式明确区分、分别存档。
section: 小队护送远征：让当前任务进入战场

text: dsh-whileplay README · 小队护送远征：让当前任务进入战场：**操作：** `WASD` / 方向键或拖动战机移动，自动射击；`Space` 闪避冲刺，`Q` 消耗修复支援，`E` 消耗空袭支援，`Escape` 暂停。能量拾取提升火力，连击增加得分；战机或运输船生命耗尽时本局结束，不影响真实任务。
section: 小队护送远征：让当前任务进入战场

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 三款游戏，三种任务玩法：| 游戏 | 经典玩法 | 工具调用带来的目标 | 完成一步任务后的补给 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **飞机大战** | 上下左右移动，自动射击 | 扫描机弹幕、运输机货舱、装甲机弱点、重装机蓄力炮 | 双发、护盾、炸弹，以及二选一成长升级 |
| **坦克大战** | 穿越砖墙与钢墙，射击敌坦克、守卫基地 | 需要命中三次的精英坦克 | 连发、护盾、战场炸弹 |
| **贪吃蛇** | 吃食物增长，避开边界和自己 | 带工具名称的限时奖励果实 | 双倍得分、护盾、减速 |

工具生成的目标按游戏规则参与本局，直到被击败、收集或离场。游戏胜负与任务执行相互独立。飞机大战的工具目标同时最多两个，密集调用依次入场。
section: 三款游戏，三种任务玩法

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 操作：- **飞机大战**：方向键移动，也可在画布上拖动；自动发射子弹。升级出现时，接住其中一枚胶囊，或点击升级按钮、按 `1` / `2` 选择。
- **坦克大战**：方向键移动和转向，`Space` 射击。砖墙可击碎，钢墙不可破坏，双方子弹可以互相抵消。玩家有 3 条生命，生命耗尽或基地被击毁时结束。
- **贪吃蛇**：方向键转向，收集食物与奖励果实。

点击画布后即可使用键盘。窗口内也提供方向与射击按钮；按 `Escape` 收起游戏窗口。
section: 操作

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 飞机大战：这次任务，换一种打法：搜索扫描机会预警扇形弹幕；读取运输机的货舱被打中后释放补给；工程装甲机需要攻击侧翼弱点，或等待护甲打开；命令重装机锁定位置后发射重炮。工具目标入场后独立参与战斗，工具返回不会让它突然消失。

Step 完成除了掉落补给，还会逐步解锁二选一升级。**火力**从双发成长为散射和穿透；**生存**提供护盾、护盾再生与一次紧急救援；**机动**提高速度，最终可以通过擦弹得分与充能。错过升级胶囊也能通过按钮稍后领取。每条路线最多三级，后续升级所需 Step 逐渐增加。

密集工具调用按双机编队依次入场，编队之间留有间隔，超过等待容量的调用会折算成有限的额外补给；工具稀疏时仍有普通敌机。飞机大战的「联动演练」包含四类敌机、密集编队、补给和成长选择，随时可以暂停。
section: 飞机大战：这次任务，换一种打法

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 接住道具，改变这一局：AI 每完成一步（Step），就会送来一份补给，拾取额外 +20 分。飞机道具向下飘落，坦克道具出现在可达的空闲通道，贪吃蛇道具出现在空白格。坦克与贪吃蛇的道具、奖励果实保留 12 秒。

| 道具 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| **双发 / 连发 / 双倍得分** | 分别增强飞机火力、坦克射速或贪吃蛇得分，持续 8 秒；重复拾取刷新时长。 |
| **护盾** | 抵挡一次伤害，不叠加。贪吃蛇会尝试转向相邻安全格；没有安全方向时仍结束本局。 |
| **清屏炸弹** | 飞机清除敌弹、击毁普通敌机，对 Boss 造成 6 点伤害；坦克清除敌弹和敌坦克，保留墙体与基地。 |
| **减速** | 贪吃蛇移动速度降低，持续 8 秒，给转向留出更多时间。 |

击落工具飞机 +100 分，击毁精英坦克 +200 分，吃到工具果实 +30 分并增长一格。贪吃蛇双倍得分期间，普通食物、工具果实与补给的拾取得分均翻倍。暂停期间，道具倒计时与加成时间一并冻结。
section: 接住道具，改变这一局

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 国际象棋与五子棋：落一子，等一个好答案：在游戏库的 **「棋类」** 分类中选择国际象棋或五子棋。默认与轻量本地电脑对弈，也可切换 **「本地双人」**，在同一棋盘轮流落子。电脑计算在浏览器内完成，无需模型、API Key 或在线对手。

| 游戏 | 规则与操作 | 人机对弈 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **国际象棋** | 点击棋子查看合法落点，再点击目标格；支持将军、将杀、王车易位、吃过路兵和四种升变 | 你执白先行，电脑执黑；适合休闲练习 |
| **五子棋** | 15×15 棋盘，横、竖或斜向五连获胜；长连也算胜利，无禁手 | 你执黑先行，电脑执白；电脑会争胜并防守直接威胁 |

每局提供棋谱、最后一手标记和悔棋；五子棋会高亮获胜连线。人机模式悔棋退回到你落子前，双人模式退回一手。棋盘支持鼠标、触屏，以及方向键移动焦点后按 Enter 落子。

**胜负有落点，下一局有入口。** 人机对弈结束时弹出「你赢了」或「本局落败」，双人模式显示获胜方，和棋单独展示。点击「查看棋盘」回看终局，点击「再来一局」立即开始。未结束的棋局重开前会弹出居中确认框，避免误清空。
section: 国际象棋与五子棋：落一子，等一个好答案

text: dsh-whileplay README · 国际象棋与五子棋：落一子，等一个好答案：两款棋类按会话在当前浏览器自动存档，切换游戏或刷新后手动继续。极简模式收起说明与棋谱，保留棋盘和操作按钮。任务结束、需要审批或页面失焦时自动暂停；工具调用不会改变棋盘规则或替你落子。
section: 国际象棋与五子棋：落一子，等一个好答案

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 小窗游玩，随时回到会话：- **移动与缩放**：拖动标题栏或点状手柄移动窗口，拖动四边或四角调整大小。进入游戏、切换棋类和返回游戏库共用同一窗口位置与尺寸，调整后不会跳回原处。调整窗口时游戏暂停，点击「继续」即可恢复。
- **极简模式（经典游戏）**：收起游戏库、标题和工具栏，只保留游戏画面。鼠标移入画面即可找到移动、暂停和恢复完整模式的按钮；触屏上始终显示这些控件。
- **自动暂停**：会话结束运行、需要审批或补充信息、状态不可用时暂停。切出浏览器窗口或隐藏页面也会暂停，回到游戏后手动继续。

飞机大战会在当前浏览器中按会话保存最近八份存档，包含战场、道具、升级和演练进度；切换游戏、切换会话或刷新后可以手动继续，恢复时有短暂准备时间。「重新开始」或重新启动演练会覆盖该会话的飞机存档。浏览器禁止存储时会显示提示。

坦克和贪吃蛇在当前页面收起窗口后保留进度，切换游戏或会话、刷新后重新开局。窗口布局刷新后重置；最高分保存在当前浏览器中。任务结束时会暂停并显示本次结算，可以先返回会话，稍后继续飞机大战。
section: 小窗游玩，随时回到会话

text: dsh-whileplay README · 小窗游玩，随时回到会话：远征按会话分别保存真实护航和演练进度，刷新后手动继续。真实任务的请求摘要、Todo 文本、Agent 名称和交付文件名不写入游戏存档；工具参数、输出和文件内容不进入游戏。
section: 小窗游玩，随时回到会话

text:
dsh-whileplay README · 常见问题：**需要配置模型或 API Key 吗？**

小游戏和「联动演练」都无需模型或 API Key，也不会额外发起模型请求。使用真实任务联动时，按 DeepSeek Harness 的要求配置并启动 AI 任务即可。

**演练按钮为什么不可用？**

三款经典游戏在当前会话执行任务或等待你的操作时禁用演练，真实任务开始后自动接入会话进度。远征通过「当前会话 / 联动演练」手动切换；真实会话需要处理交互时，两种模式都会暂停。

**页面提示 authentication required，或任务提示 no API key？**

前者是网页访问认证：重新打开 `dsh web` 启动时输出的完整 URL。后者是模型凭据缺失：在 **设置 → 模型** 中填写并保存相应提供商的 API Key，再选择模型重新发送任务。独立 `DSH_HOME` 数据目录需要单独配置凭据。

**如何升级或卸载？**

text: dsh-whileplay README · Whileplay · 玩一小局：Whileplay is a task-linked arcade plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Your conversation's Todos become island waypoints, tool calls bring interceptors and supplies, completed subagents join your flight, and delivered files board the transport ship. Move, shoot, dodge, and protect the convoy while AI works.

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Whileplay · 玩一小局：Six games, two ways to spend the wait: Air Battle, Tank Battle, and Snake turn tool activity into targets and supplies. Chess and Gomoku offer a quieter challenge against a local computer opponent or a friend on the same board.

Keep playing while AI works. When the conversation stops running or needs your input, the game pauses so you can return to it.

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Why try Whileplay?：- **Each task has its own journey.** The mission title, Todos, subagent flight, and cargo manifest follow your current conversation. Missing data stays visibly empty.
- **Real-time action you control.** Move in four directions, fire automatically, dash through danger, repair the convoy, and call air support. Game outcomes never control AI execution.
- **Six games for different moods.** Move, shoot, and escort, or take on a local computer opponent or friend. Board games end with a clear result screen.
- **Put the game where you want it.** Move and resize the floating window. Opening a game and returning to the library preserves its position and size. Classic and board games offer minimal modes.
- **Return when you are needed.** The game pauses when the conversation stops running, awaits approval, or asks for input. Resume the round when you are ready.
- **Try it right after installation.** The four action and arcade games include model-free demos; both board games offer local play. Classic and board games support Chinese and English with light and dark themes; Convoy Escort currently has a Chinese interface.
section: Why try Whileplay?

text: dsh-whileplay README · See it in action：Open Whileplay beside the chat composer and explore task-linked targets and power-ups in Air Battle, Tank Battle, and Snake.
section: See it in action

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Quick start：You need DeepSeek Harness with its Web profile, Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, and npm. The current version has been verified with Harness `0.2.1-alpha.4`; other host versions have not been verified.

**1. Download the plugin.** [Download the v0.4.0 package](https://github.com/monster-cli/dsh-whileplay/releases/download/v0.4.0/dsh-whileplay-0.4.0.tgz), including Convoy Escort, Air Battle, Tank Battle, Snake, Chess, and Gomoku. No source checkout or build is required.
section: Quick start

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Quick start：**2. Install and start.** Run these commands in the directory containing the package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-whileplay-0.4.0.tgz
dsh web
```

Restart the Web profile after installation if Harness Web is already running.

<details>
<summary>No global dsh command? Use npx</summary>

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-whileplay-0.4.0.tgz
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

</details>
section: Quick start

text: dsh-whileplay README · Start playing：Open the **complete URL** printed by `dsh web` to authenticate the browser. Click **“◈ Play a little”** beside the chat composer and choose a game. For action and arcade games, choose **“Try task escort”** to explore targets and supplies. For Chess or Gomoku, click **“Start game”** to begin a round.
section: Start playing

text: dsh-whileplay README · Start playing：For live integration, configure your provider credentials in DSH **Settings → Models**, select a model, and run a task. Whileplay follows the current **DSH conversation**, not tasks in other applications, and makes no additional model calls.
section: Start playing

text: dsh-whileplay README · Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield：Escort a transport ship past islands and reefs while protecting it from enemy attacks. Movement, automatic targeting, dodging, and supply collection form a continuous action game. Task details appear both on the battlefield and in the mission briefing.
section: Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield：| What happens in your task | What happens in the game |
| --- | --- |
| Todos are created or updated | Waypoints show real Todo titles and statuses; the route follows task progress |
| A tool is called | An interceptor labeled with the tool name enters; its flight continues after the tool returns |
| A tool succeeds / a Step ends | Firepower / shield supplies arrive for you to collect |
| A subagent completes its work | Subagents confirmed complete in the current turn provide up to two wingmen |
| Files are presented for delivery | The transport displays their filenames; ordinary file writes do not count as delivery |
| The conversation stops or needs input | The battlefield pauses so you can return; stopping alone does not mean the task succeeded |
section: Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield

text: dsh-whileplay README · Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield：The default **当前会话 (Current conversation)** mode uses real data, with explicit empty states for missing Todos, subagents, or deliveries. Switch to **联动演练 (Demo)** to play the complete Pomodoro-site example. The two modes are clearly labeled and save separately.
section: Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield

text: dsh-whileplay README · Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield：**Controls:** `WASD`, arrow keys, or dragging to move; automatic fire; `Space` to dash; `Q` to spend repair support; `E` to spend air support; `Escape` to pause. Energy pickups upgrade firepower and combos increase points. Losing the aircraft or transport ends the round without affecting the real task.
section: Convoy Escort: your current task on the battlefield

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Three games, three ways to play along：| Game | Classic gameplay | Targets from tool calls | Supplies from completed steps |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Air Battle** | Move in all four directions and fire automatically | Scanner bursts, transport cargo, armor weak spots, charged cannons | Twin shot, shield, bomb, and a choice of growth upgrades |
| **Tank Battle** | Break through bricks, navigate steel walls, and defend your base | Armored enemy tanks that take three hits | Rapid fire, shield, battlefield bomb |
| **Snake** | Eat, grow, and avoid the walls and your own body | Timed bonus fruit labeled with tool names | Double score, shield, slow motion |
section: Three games, three ways to play along

text: dsh-whileplay README · Three games, three ways to play along：Once spawned, task targets follow the game's rules until defeated, collected, or gone. Game outcomes and task execution are independent. Air Battle shows at most two tool targets at once; bursts of calls wait their turn.
section: Three games, three ways to play along

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Controls：- **Air Battle:** use the arrow keys or drag on the canvas to move. Your aircraft fires automatically. Catch one upgrade capsule, click an upgrade button, or press `1` / `2` to choose.
- **Tank Battle:** use the arrow keys to move and turn, and `Space` to fire. Bricks can be destroyed; steel blocks shots. Opposing bullets cancel each other out. You have three lives; losing them or losing the base ends the round.
- **Snake:** use the arrow keys to turn and collect food and bonus fruit.
section: Controls

text: dsh-whileplay README · Controls：Click the canvas to use keyboard controls. The window also provides direction and fire buttons. Press `Escape` to collapse it.
section: Controls

text: dsh-whileplay README · Air Battle: a different approach to each task：Search scanners telegraph fan-shaped bursts. Damaging a read transport's cargo releases a supply. Engineering aircraft have side weak spots and periodically open their armor. Command aircraft lock a position before firing a charged cannon. Spawned targets follow their own game rules regardless of when the tool returns.
section: Air Battle: a different approach to each task

text: dsh-whileplay README · Air Battle: a different approach to each task：Completed Steps gradually unlock two-option upgrades alongside regular supplies. **Firepower** grows from twin shot to spread and piercing bullets. **Survival** adds a shield, shield regeneration, and one emergency rescue. **Mobility** increases speed and eventually rewards near misses with points and charge. Missed upgrade capsules remain claimable through the buttons. Each path has three levels; later choices require more Steps.
section: Air Battle: a different approach to each task

text: dsh-whileplay README · Air Battle: a different approach to each task：Dense tool activity enters as pairs with a gap between formations. Calls beyond the visual queue become limited extra supplies, while ordinary aircraft keep the field active between tool events. The Air Battle rehearsal includes all four archetypes, dense formations, supplies, and growth choices, and can be paused anytime.
section: Air Battle: a different approach to each task

text: dsh-whileplay README · Catch a power-up. Change the round.：Every completed AI step sends a supply worth an extra +20 points when collected. Aircraft supplies drift downward, tank supplies appear in reachable open lanes, and Snake supplies appear on free cells. Tank and Snake supplies, and bonus fruit, remain for 12 seconds.
section: Catch a power-up. Change the round.

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Catch a power-up. Change the round.：| Power-up | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| **Twin shot / rapid fire / double score** | Boosts aircraft firepower, tank firing rate, or Snake scoring for 8 seconds. Collecting another refreshes the duration. |
| **Shield** | Absorbs one hit and does not stack. Snake tries to turn into an adjacent safe cell; the round still ends if no safe turn exists. |
| **Bomb** | In Air Battle, clears enemy shots, destroys ordinary aircraft, and deals 6 damage to bosses. In Tank Battle, clears enemy shots and tanks while preserving walls and the base. |
| **Slow motion** | Slows Snake for 8 seconds, giving you more time to turn. |
section: Catch a power-up. Change the round.

text: dsh-whileplay README · Catch a power-up. Change the round.：Destroying a tool aircraft awards +100 points; an armored tool tank, +200. Tool fruit awards +30 and grows the snake by one cell. Snake's double-score effect applies to ordinary food, tool fruit, and supply pickups. Supply lifetimes and active effects freeze while paused.
section: Catch a power-up. Change the round.

text: dsh-whileplay README · Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies：Choose Chess or Gomoku in the library's **Board** category. Play against a casual local computer opponent, or select **Two players** to take turns on the same board. The opponent runs entirely in your browser: no model, API key, or online opponent is required.
section: Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies

text:
dsh-whileplay README · Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies：| Game | Rules and controls | Computer mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Chess** | Select a piece to see legal moves, then select a destination. Supports check, checkmate, castling, en passant, and all four promotions | You play White and move first; the computer plays Black. Designed for casual practice |
| **Gomoku** | Connect five horizontally, vertically, or diagonally on a 15×15 board. Freestyle rules: overlines win, no forbidden moves | You play Black and move first; the computer plays White, pursuing wins and blocking immediate threats |
section: Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies

text: dsh-whileplay README · Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies：Both games include move history, last-move highlights, and undo. Gomoku highlights the winning line. Computer-mode undo returns to before your last move; two-player undo removes one move. Use a mouse or touch, or navigate the board with arrow keys and press Enter to move.
section: Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies

text: dsh-whileplay README · Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies：**A clear result, an easy rematch.** Computer games show “You win!” or “You lost this round”; two-player games name the winner, and draws have their own result screen. Review the final board or play again immediately. Restarting an unfinished round requires confirmation in a centered dialog.
section: Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies

text: dsh-whileplay README · Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies：Games save automatically per conversation in the current browser and resume manually after switching games or refreshing. Minimal mode hides instructions and history while retaining the board and controls. Task completion, pending input, or leaving the page pauses play. Tool calls never change chess rules or make your moves.
section: Chess and Gomoku: a thoughtful move between replies

text:
dsh-whileplay README · A small window, an easy return to work：- **Move and resize:** drag the title bar or dotted handle to move the window; drag any edge or corner to resize it. Opening a game, switching board games, and returning to the library preserve the same position and size, including your adjustments. Adjusting the window pauses the game. Click “Resume” when ready.
- **Minimal mode (classic games):** hide the library, heading, and toolbar, leaving just the game. Hover to reveal move, pause, and restore controls. These controls stay visible on touch devices.
- **Automatic pauses:** the game pauses when the conversation stops running, awaits approval or input, or its status becomes unavailable. Leaving the browser window or hiding the page also pauses it. Resume manually when you return.
section: A small window, an easy return to work

text: dsh-whileplay README · A small window, an easy return to work：Air Battle keeps the eight most recent session checkpoints in your current browser, including the field, supplies, upgrades, and rehearsal progress. After switching games or conversations, or refreshing, resume manually with a short preparation period. Restarting the round or rehearsal replaces that session's Air Battle checkpoint. A message appears if browser storage is unavailable.
section: A small window, an easy return to work

text: dsh-whileplay README · A small window, an easy return to work：Tank Battle and Snake preserve progress while collapsed on the current page; switching games or conversations, or refreshing, starts a fresh round. Refreshing resets window layout. Best scores stay in the current browser. A task ending pauses the game and displays a summary: return to the conversation, then continue Air Battle later.
section: A small window, an easy return to work

text: dsh-whileplay README · A small window, an easy return to work：Convoy Escort saves live play and demo progress separately for each session and resumes manually after refresh. Real request summaries, Todo text, subagent names, and delivery filenames are not written to game checkpoints. Tool arguments, outputs, and file contents do not enter the game.
section: A small window, an easy return to work

text:
dsh-whileplay README · FAQ：**Do I need a model or API key?**

The games and task-escort demo need neither, and make no additional model requests. For live task-linked play, configure and run an AI task as you normally would in DeepSeek Harness.

**Why is “Try task escort” disabled?**
section: FAQ

text:
dsh-whileplay README · FAQ：The three classic games disable demos while the conversation is running or awaiting input, and automatically follow a real task when it starts. Convoy Escort uses an explicit Current conversation / Demo switch. Both escort modes pause when the real conversation needs your input.

**What do “authentication required” and “no API key” mean?**
section: FAQ

text:
dsh-whileplay README · FAQ：The first concerns browser access: reopen the complete URL printed when `dsh web` starts. The second means model credentials are missing: save the appropriate provider's API key in **Settings → Models**, select a model, and send the task again. A separate `DSH_HOME` data directory needs its own credential configuration.

**How do I upgrade or uninstall?**
section: FAQ

text:
dsh-whileplay README · FAQ：To upgrade, download the new `.tgz`, run the installation command again, and restart the Web profile. To uninstall, run the command below, then restart the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-whileplay
```

If you run Harness through npm, use `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-whileplay`. Uninstalling does not automatically clear best scores stored in your browser.
